d: The Timberwolves defeated the Rockets, 117-107 tonight in Houston. Ayo Dosunmu contributed a team-high 21 points to go with 6 assists and 2 steals, with LaMelo Ball of the Timberwolves adding an additional 20 points (6-11 FG, 4-7 3P), 6 assists, and 4 3PM in the game. Kevin Durant finished with a team-high 21 points along with 5 rebounds for the Rockets in the losing effort. The Timberwolves improve their record to 6-3 with the win, while the Rockets fall to 7-2 for the season.
